=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "The judge comment carries the capped sentence on both the accepted and the failed path."
  Expected change site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, `security_pass_exhaustion_judge()`, the early-terminalization branch at lines 7086-7097 (the `if [ "${keep_fixing_capped}" = "true" ] && [ "${fixing_count}" -gt 0 ]` arm) — the `${capped_suffix}` interpolation point.
  Evidence of absence: When a verdict mixes low/medium `keep_fixing` (which get rewritten to `accept_with_followup` by the cap on lines 7066-7080, populating `capped_suffix`) with high/critical/unrated `keep_fixing` (which stay as `keep_fixing`), `fixing_count` stays `> 0` and the early-terminalization arm fires. That arm posts its `## ⚖️ Security-pass exhaustion judge (round ${judge_round})` tracking comment with the literal text `"The extra fix-cycle budget (\`MAX_SECURITY_PASS_KEEP_FIXING_ROUNDS=${MAX_SECURITY_PASS_KEEP_FIXING_ROUNDS}\`) is spent. ${fixing_count} blocking finding(s) still need \`keep_fixing\`, so the pass is terminalized as \`ai:security-pass-failed\` without recording any new waivers or follow-ups."` and no `${capped_suffix}` interpolation. The diff only added `${capped_suffix}` to the later `failed_count > 0` arm (line 7104) and the all-accepted arm (line 7208). Operators hitting this path therefore see no acknowledgement that the cap did rewrite low/medium findings to advisories before they were discarded — the discarded conversion is invisible in the tracking comment even though the prompt now invites the judge to choose mixed actions on capped rounds. The only tests that cover this branch (`test_security_pass_cap_mixed_blocking_and_low_keep_fixing_waives_nothing`, `test_security_pass_cap_never_waives_a_high_finding`, `test_security_pass_cap_does_not_record_advisories_before_terminal_failure`) assert only `"without recording any new waivers or follow-ups"`, the `| SEC-TEST-1 | high |` row and the `reason=blocking_findings_after_cap` log line, so the missing sentence is silently uncovered.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  Requirement: "The judge comment carries the capped sentence on both the accepted and the failed path."
  Expected change site: `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, `security_pass_exhaustion_judge()`, the terminalization branch at lines 7086-7097 for remaining high/critical/unrated `keep_fixing` findings
  Evidence of absence: When `keep_fixing_capped=true` AND `fixing_count > 0` (meaning high, critical, or unrated `keep_fixing` findings remain after the cap conversion), the code at lines 7086-7097 posts a tracking comment that says "The extra fix-cycle budget ... is spent. N blocking finding(s) still need `keep_fixing`, so the pass is terminalized as `ai:security-pass-failed` without recording any new waivers or follow-ups." This comment does NOT include `${capped_suffix}`, which would note that some low/medium findings were converted to advisories. The `capped_suffix` is included in the `failed_count > 0` path (line 7104) and the all-accepted path (line 7208), but not in this third terminalization path. This contradicts the PR description's claim that the capped sentence appears on "both the accepted and the failed path" — there are actually three terminalization paths, and one is missing the capped sentence.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
